name: record_contact_restriction
description: Record an explicit caller opt-out for specified channels or withdraw this inquiry callback. This only restricts contact. Does not grant permission or reopen a callback. Retry an uncertain save with exactly the same UUID and arguments.

request_id.description: New UUID for an intentional save; keep the same ID and exact arguments on an uncertain retry.

channels.description: For do_not_contact use only requested channels, nonempty; all must be alone. No calls means human_voice, ai_voice and prerecorded. For cancel_callback use an empty array.
